title: Rumoured Badlands incident in which two security policemen were found unclothed

tellings.quote: there were rumors years before I got there that something happened down toward the Badlands in the 66th area and uh where two security policemen were found uh out of their vehicle

plain: Around 1977, two Air Force security policemen guarding nuclear missile sites in the 66th missile area near the Badlands of South Dakota were said to have been found out of their vehicle and unclothed. Mario Woods, a former nuclear missile guard, tells Michels he heard this as a rumor from years before he arrived there. He tells it alongside his own account of a UFO abduction, as a sign that strange things happened to guards in that area.
